answer: Forging a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes, each slashed if its referral link fails peer audit. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake bonds tied to a reputation vine: each new agent must lock a real walnut-valued stake, and rewards grow only along a verified referral chain rooted at a known identity. The cost curve sits on a steep ledge: honest agents pay once, attackers pay per identity and lose everything on detection. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
